Upon realizing that she has been reincarnated as the villainess from the otome game she played in her previous life, Liliana—the duke’s daughter and a candidate for the crown prince’s fiancée—finds herself constantly targeted for assassination by her father’s political rivals and foreign agents. To make matters worse, an illness has left her unable to speak. With no way to cry out for help when attacked or to chant spells for magic, her path seemed destined only for ruin… or so it appeared.
(If I can’t speak, then why not simply master chantless magic? Oh—look at that, I’ve gone and done it.)
And so, drawing those around her into the fray, she thwarts a monstrous stampede and dismantles a human trafficking syndicate… All while striving to steer clear of the story’s entanglements, Liliana unleashes her unparalleled prowess!! The mightiest protagonist (heroine) shatters her fated (scripted) destiny with her genius-level (cheat-tier) magic and intellect in this isekai reincarnation × shadowy intrigue battle fantasy—now commencing.
associated_names: The Villainess Speaks Not
悪役令嬢はしゃべりません

146564.synopsis:
When he opened his eyes, Luca Salvatore found himself reincarnated into the world of his favorite game.
He was born into the Salvatore Ducal House—the most powerful and prodigious family from the MMORPG Monochrome Blade.
But at the same time, the Salvatore family was known for something else—they were the villainous clan that meddled with the main storyline.
“A villain doomed to be defeated, huh…? Sounds perfect. I’ll wipe out the bad endings and the original protagonist!”
Despite the hopeless situation he was born into, even as a baby, Luca resolved to become the strongest.
At the root of his determination was the soul of a hardcore gamer who had explored every corner of the game in his previous life.
The scripted storylines standing in his way.
The protagonist of the original game, now an enemy.
The twisted siblings aiming for his life.
Armed with the knowledge of his past life and an insatiable thirst for mastery—
he’ll crush them all.
associated_names: 最強の悪役が往く～実力至上主義の一族に転生した俺は、世界最強の剣士へと至る～

149892.synopsis:
A knight of prophecy is said to be the one who will save an empire on the brink of destruction.
And the only person who can find him is the Saint.
That Saint is me.
But I never managed to find the knight,
and after being accused of being a fake Saint, I was thrown into prison.
Right before I died, I finally met the knight of prophecy—
in the prison of all places. Seriously, does that make any sense? It’s so unfair!
Just when I thought my life as a Saint had completely failed,
I suddenly regressed.
This time, I have only one goal:
Awaken the knight of prophecy as fast as possible and then retire!
Being a Saint never suited me anyway.
I want to quit as soon as possible and live freely.
So I disguised myself as a rookie member of the mercenary group where the knight was,
planning to awaken him with a kiss and then run away.
But then—
“Honestly… you really toy with my heart.”
“Don’t ever get hurt in my place again.”
“The place you belong is here, Liana.”
Huh? Something’s wrong.
This wasn’t part of the plan.
“Don’t leave my side. Promise you’ll be with me every moment.”
Sir Knight…why are you so obsessed with me?
associated_names: I Quit Being a Saint and Became a Mercenary!

150660.synopsis:
If you travel back to the Song Dynasty, should you recite poetry and appreciate the arts, or should you train your troops and conquer the world?
No matter what, you need to fill your stomach first.
associated_names: 北宋穿越指南

156548.synopsis:
If one does not enter reincarnation, one can never resolve fate. I was originally a stranger, becoming a king along the way!
Transmigrated into Full Magic, relying entirely on foresight!
As for eliminating Termites, cultivating to the peak of magic, and slaughtering Demon clans, those are just incidental matters, not worth mentioning.
The Totems under my command are all Emperors; cultivation and slaughter are both pursued without fail!
When Demons run rampant invading the Human City, a single Thunder Punishment wipes out their entire clan!
associated_names: 全职法师：空间之主

198020.synopsis:
In her previous life, she was Bai Zi Hua’s disciple. For him, she endured seventeen Soul Severing Nails and one hundred and three swords. Ultimately, she died when the Xuanyuan Sword pierced her heart.
Before her death, she cast a curse: “Bai Zi Hua, in the name of a god, I curse you. In this life, for all eternity, may you never age, never die, never be harmed, and never be destroyed.”
Returning in rebirth, she was back at seventeen. The Gathering of Immortals Banquet had not yet begun, and she had not yet fallen in love with anyone.
This time, she would not join Chang Liu, nor would she beg for love in a lowly manner. She would make everyone who had wronged her pay the price. But when she refused Bai Zi Hua’s request to take her as a disciple, the Immortal Realm was shaken.
Six male gods from immortal sects began to dote on her. Sha Qian Mo: “In this life, it’s my turn to save you.” Dong Fang Yu Qing: “The secret within you, I will uncover it with you.” Xuan Yuan Lang: “With half the rivers and mountains as my betrothal gift, is that enough?” Tan Fan, Wu Gou, Bai Zi Hua: “We are all waiting for you.”
Six male gods vied for her affection, but she only wanted to say— “In this life, I want to be my own god.”
associated_names: 仙门团宠：花千骨重生成了万人迷
